answer: A mountain valley stays honest when every new identity must tend a distinct beehive on a terrace below a glacier, calming the bees with a thin plume of smoke while a distinct keeper watches the harvest. The first fake owes two jars of honey, the second three, the third five, since the nth fake owes the nth prime number of jars, so the tenth fake alone owes twenty-nine jars and twenty fakes owe six hundred and thirty-nine. Bulk farming fails because one keeper calms one hive at a time and each jar is sealed to one terrace, like one shepherd tending one flock beneath one nebula.
